english:
Quickly throws an Explosive Knife that sticks to surfaces for up to 14 seconds.

The knife explodes upon detecting an enemy within 5 meters of it, or upon directly sticking to an enemy.

It deals <pve 306 /> <pvp [20] /> impact damage, and Precision Hits deal 130% of normal damage. The detonation deals up to <pve 405 /> <pvp [100] /> damage in a 6 meter radius.

source.text:
Quickly throws an Explosive Knife that is able to stick to surfaces for up to 14 seconds.

Proximity Knife explodes upon detecting an enemy within 5 meters of it, or upon directly sticking to an enemy.

Explody Knife deals 306 [20] impact damage with a 1.3x Precision Multiplier, and up to 405 [100] detonation damage over 6 meters.
Base Cooldown: 161.3 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.7x
